question: Where can I find a park inside a 150 kilometers radius toward the southeast of Fireside Farm & Sawmill, Efland, NC?
sql: WITH FiresideFarm AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS farm_centroid_geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Fireside Farm & Sawmill%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Efland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P, FiresideFarm AS FF WHERE ST_DWithin( P.geometry::geography, FF.farm_centroid_geom::geography, 150000 -- 150 kilometers in meters ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( FF.farm_centroid_geom, ST_Centroid(P.geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;
